article_title: Schools to offer technical subjects to pupils from age 14 in England, Burnham says

tasks.prompt: What is the central proposal described in the article?
options: Replace all academic GCSE subjects with apprenticeships
Allow pupils from age 14 to study technical subjects linked to local employment needs
Move responsibility for every school directly to private employers
tasks.correct_answer: Allow pupils from age 14 to study technical subjects linked to local employment needs
tasks.explanation_hebrew: ההצעה המרכזית היא לאפשר מגיל 14 לימודים טכניים ומקצועיים המותאמים לצורכי התעסוקה המקומיים.

tasks.prompt: Which subjects are given as examples of the proposed technical courses?
tasks.explanation_hebrew: בכתבה מובאים בינה מלאכותית וייצור כדוגמאות לתחומים טכניים הקשורים למשרות מקומיות.

tasks.prompt: Who would work together to shape locally relevant technical training?
options: Parents and pupils without schools or employers
Local leaders, schools, colleges, and employers
tasks.correct_answer: Local leaders, schools, colleges, and employers
tasks.explanation_hebrew: התוכנית מבוססת על שיתוף פעולה בין הנהגה מקומית, בתי ספר, מכללות ומעסיקים.

tasks.prompt: When is the new local technical-education approach intended to begin operating?
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לפי התוכנית המתוארת, השינוי אמור להתחיל לפעול בספטמבר 2028.

tasks.prompt: How is the proposal intended to address youth unemployment and skills shortages at the same time? Answer in 3–6 sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר את הקשר בין הכשרה מגיל 14, צורכי מעסיקים מקומיים, מסלולי תעסוקה ומחסור בכישורים.
expected_points: Courses would be linked to skills needed by local employers
Pupils would gain clearer technical or vocational routes into work
Employers could gain workers trained for shortage sectors
The policy responds to the large number of young people outside education, employment, or training

tasks.prompt: What does Burnham's contrast between the “hard hat” and the “graduation cap” reveal about the reform's values? Answer in 3–5 sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לפרש את הדימוי כהשוואה בין מסלול טכני למסלול אקדמי ולדון בשאיפה למעמד שווה.
expected_points: The hard hat represents technical or vocational work
The graduation cap represents the academic route
The proposal aims to give both routes equal respect and value
It challenges the traditional bias toward academic qualifications

tasks.prompt: In the article, what does “vocational” mean?
options: Connected with training for a particular job or occupation
tasks.correct_answer: Connected with training for a particular job or occupation
tasks.explanation_hebrew: vocational מתאר לימודים או הכשרה שמכינים למקצוע ולעבודה מסוימת.

tasks.prompt: Write a 120–170 word summary of the article without copying sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: הסיכום צריך להציג את ההצעה, דרך היישום המקומית, היעדים הכלכליים והחברתיים, והוויכוח על מעמד החינוך הטכני.
expected_points: Pupils in England would be able to take technical subjects from age 14
Examples include artificial intelligence and manufacturing
Local leaders, schools, colleges, and employers would align courses with local jobs
The plan seeks to tackle youth unemployment and skills shortages
Technical and vocational routes would receive recognition alongside academic qualifications

tasks.prompt: Assess in 4–7 sentences one potential benefit and one potential risk of adapting school courses to local business needs.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציג יתרון וסיכון, לקשור את שניהם לפרטי התוכנית ולהגיע למסקנה מאוזנת.
expected_points: A benefit could be stronger pathways into available local jobs or reduced skills shortages
A risk could be narrowing pupils' choices or tying education too closely to current labour demand
Use the proposed partnership with local employers and education providers
Reach a balanced conclusion rather than giving an unsupported opinion

tasks.prompt: Explain in 4–7 sentences why funding and inspection rules matter to whether the reform succeeds.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר כיצד משאבים, תמריצים והכרה מצד גוף הפיקוח משפיעים על היכולת של בתי הספר ליישם את המסלולים בפועל.
expected_points: Technical courses require sufficient teaching capacity, equipment, and qualified staff
Prioritised funding or incentives can make implementation possible
Inspection guidance can ensure vocational qualifications receive recognition alongside academic ones
Without clear support, schools may continue to prioritise traditional academic routes
